subject: SOC 2 recertification — scope, retention uplift, and term amendment
messages:
From: Elizabeth Morris <elizabeth.morris@bluepeak.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@bluepeak.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recertification window + retention ask

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well — as part of our upcoming renewal we need to confirm Redwood's SOC 2 recertification timeline and a couple of scope items that will affect our procurement decision. Specifically: 

- Will the recertification cover the additional log retention we discussed (archive + enhanced audit window for 24 months)?
- We may need a temporary burst capacity (up to +35% throughput) during our audit evidence handoff window (2–3 weeks).
- Pricing impact for the retention uplift and temporary capacity — procurement wants an estimate and any required term amendment.

Can you share a mutual action plan for the recert and a rough cost delta? We want to lock dates with our internal compliance team by next week.

Thanks,
Elizabeth Morris
Head of Security & Compliance
BluePeak Financial

Attachments: none

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elizabeth Morris <elizabeth.morris@bluepeak.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification window + retention ask

Hi Elizabeth — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (pricing/finance) and Marissa (account lead) so we can put together a short MAP and a term amendment draft. Quick answers up front:

- Scope: Yes — we can extend the audit log retention to 24 months for your account and include that in the SOC 2 evidence package. We'll surface any artifact collection differences in the MAP.
- Burst capacity: we can provision a 2–3 week burst (auto-burst policy) up to +35% throughput; there are two execution options (reserved burst vs on-demand burst) with different unit economics.
- Timeline: propose recert evidence window = Aug 10–24, 2026 to align with your internal auditors.

Action items:
1) Kimberly: provide pricing delta for (a) 24-month retention, (b) 2–3 week +35% burst, and (c) combined discounted term amendment if BluePeak renews for 12–18 months.
2) Marissa: draft MAP with deliverables, list of artifacts we will pull, and an evidence collection cadence.
3) Elizabeth/Tanya: confirm auditor availability during Aug 10–24 and whether you need on-prem ingest support.

I'll attach our SOC2 snapshot and a MAP template for your review — attaching SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf and a starter MAP workbook.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf; BluePeak-MAP-2026.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Elizabeth Morris <elizabeth.morris@bluepeak.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification window + retention ask

Hi all — pricing details below (ballpark for planning; legal will need to sign a short-term amendment for retention). Numbers assume current committed throughput (no additional reserved GPU pools).

1) Retention uplift to 24 months (audit log storage + retrieval SLA): one-time migration and index fee = $9,500; ongoing storage delta = $0.018 / GB / month.

2) Temporary burst capacity (2 weeks recommended minimum for handoff): on-demand burst = metered usage at standard hosted rates; estimated incremental cost for +35% for 2 weeks = $12k–$18k depending on token volume. Reserved short-term burst (30-day reserve) can be offered with a 20% discount on metered rate (~$9.6k–$14.4k).

3) Term amendment options: 12-month renewal = no additional discount; 18-month renewal = 10% credit applied to migration fee and 5% on ongoing storage delta for the first 12 months.

Next steps from pricing/legal side:
- I'll prepare a draft short amendment (term + retention language + one-time migration fee) and circulate for redline.
- Ben: can you confirm operational constraints for the burst (KV cache warm-up, expected lead time)?

Jonas — I attached the draft numbers in the MAP workbook and added an example term amendment template (term-amendment-draft.docx).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Pricing & Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BluePeak-MAP-2026.xlsx (updated); term-amendment-draft.docx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elizabeth Morris <elizabeth.morris@bluepeak.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification window + retention ask

Elizabeth — thanks for the prompt. Confirming our proposed plan so procurement has explicit asks to include in the renewal: 

1) MAP + evidence cadence: we will run a prep sprint July 27–31 to gather artifacts, then the evidence handoff Aug 10–24. Deliverables: chunked artifact bundles, live evidence review sessions (biweekly), and audit-server logs export.

2) Retention & amendment: Redwood will perform the migration to 24-month audit retention prior to Aug 1. One-time migration fee = $9,500 (Kim's estimate). We will attach the short-term amendment for signature — linking to DocuSign once legal completes redlines.

3) Burst capacity: recommend selecting the 30-day reserved burst to simplify capacity planning and reduce cost. If BluePeak signs for an 18-month renewal, we'll apply the credit terms Kimberly noted.

4) Acceptance criteria: engineer-verified exports, a signed amendment covering retention and term, and confirmation of auditor schedule.

If this looks good, Jonas and I will send the MAP and the amendment to procurement for review by EOD Friday.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
